{{Top|leg}}
The '''N21-3 power converter''' was a [[Power converter/Legends|power converter]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. N21-3s were fitted aboard the ''[[Happy Failure]]'', and the coolant tubes were salvaged to distil [[Bavva ale]].
